# Know Your Meme & TV Guide

> > A hybrid documentation site covering internet meme culture from Know Your Meme and television programming schedules from TV Guide.

This site combines two distinct content areas: Know Your Meme's comprehensive database of viral internet phenomena, memes, and trends primarily from TikTok, Twitter/X, and Reddit; and TV Guide's television listings, streaming recommendations, and entertainment news. The meme content focuses on explaining viral trends, their origins, and cultural context.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Internet memes and exploitables
- Viral meme explanations
- TV schedules and listings
- Catchphrases and internet slang
- Image macros
- Entertainment and celebrity news
- Social media platforms (Twitter/X, Reddit, Facebook)
- Dance memes and music trends
- Streaming services
- Pop culture phenomena
- Meme origins and context
- Live sports programming

## Core Resources

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com): Homepage with streaming recommendations, reviews, and entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV schedule and listings by provider for shows, movies, and programs
